description:
Updates the active conversation to use the specified backtesting data provider.

AVAILABILITY AND SETUP: Read these constraints before selecting a provider. Do not probe a provider already declared OFF by calling this tool. Explain its known unavailability and the supported alternatives instead. Preserve the named setup page when explaining a connection requirement.
- Theta Data ('theta_data') is OFF right now. Theta Data is not available on BotSpot right now. Never select it and never start a backtest on it. If the user asks for it, say plainly that it is not available and offer the alternatives below.
- 'alpaca' uses the user's connected Alpaca broker account for data. Never ask the user to add ALPACA_API_KEY or ALPACA_API_SECRET as environment variables: those names are reserved for broker connections. If Alpaca is not connected or needs reconnecting, send the user to the Broker Connections page.
- For OPTIONS: BotSpot Auto has NO options data right now because Theta Data is off, and start_backtest refuses options strategies on 'botspot_auto'. Options backtests need the user's own data: 'alpaca' when the user has a connected Alpaca account (options history from February 2024), or 'polygon' with the user's own POLYGON_API_KEY. Ask the user which one before switching. If they have neither, explain how to connect an Alpaca account (a free one works) or save a Polygon key. BotSpot does not currently have IBKR options support.

IMPORTANT: Match the provider to the strategy's asset class requirements.

Available providers and their capabilities:
- Alpaca (alpaca): stocks, options, crypto
- BotSpot Auto (botspot_auto): stocks, options, crypto, futures, indexes
- Custom Provider (custom): stocks, options, crypto, futures, indexes
- DataBento (databento): futures
- Polygon (polygon): stocks, options, crypto, indexes

RULES:
- Match the provider to the strategy's asset class requirements
- If the strategy requires an asset class the provider doesn't support, STOP and pick a compatible provider
- BotSpot Auto is a managed asset-class router. Policy version: 2026-06-26. Current routes: default → ibkr, stock → ibkr, index → ibkr, option → thetadata, crypto → coinbase, crypto_future → coinbase, future → ibkr, cont_future → ibkr.
- For STOCKS/INDEXES: Default to 'botspot_auto' (IBKR via router) unless the user explicitly requests a different provider (e.g., 'polygon' or 'alpaca')
- For SPOT CRYPTO: Default to 'botspot_auto' (Coinbase via CCXT router) unless the user explicitly requests Polygon/Alpaca for spot crypto
- For CRYPTO PERPETUAL/FUTURES: Default to 'botspot_auto' (Coinbase via CCXT router) unless the user explicitly requests a compatible futures provider
- For FUTURES: Default to 'botspot_auto' (IBKR via router) unless the user explicitly requests DataBento. If IBKR is missing/unsupported for the requested futures symbol/contract, recommend DataBento as the fallback (BYOK: the user must supply their own DataBento API key).
- If user doesn't have required API keys for a BYOK provider, recommend 'botspot_auto' for stocks, indexes, crypto and futures, or 'custom'. For options, follow the OPTIONS rule above.
- The 'custom' provider lets users supply their own data files

The tool will return capability validation warnings if there's a mismatch.
name: set_data_provider
title: Switch the conversation data source
